title: I built an AI portfolio app that tracks more than stocks, just shipped full ASX + AUD support
author: Emojinapp
selftext:
I’ve been building **Briefcase**, an iOS portfolio app that tries to sit somewhere between a portfolio tracker and an AI research assistant.  
Just shipped a pretty big update:  
Full **ASX stock support**  
Native **AUD portfolio support**  
You can now **save AI chats**  
Fixed a few pricing/tracking bugs.

For anyone seeing Briefcase for the first time, the main difference is that I didn’t want another stock-only tracker or an AI chatbot with no context about what I actually own.  
Briefcase lets you put your **whole portfolio** in one place: stocks, bonds, crypto, cash, real estate and even physical assets.  
The AI then works around that portfolio. It can research holdings using current ticker data and news, explain **why something moved**, surface news specifically affecting your assets, generate a daily portfolio brief, and alert you when one of your holdings makes a large move.  
It doesn’t execute trades for you. The goal is more to give you a research layer over the portfolio you already have, so when something moves you can quickly figure out what happened and decide what you want to do yourself.  
Would especially love feedback from anyone here who actively trades or manages portfolios across multiple markets. I’m still building it and have been adding features based heavily on what users ask for.
